author: Paulus Silentarius
title: Descriptio Ambonis (Description of the Ambo)

sources.source: Paulus Silentarius, Descriptio Ambonis. PG 86b (Migne). Also Friedländer 1912 Teubner edition. De Stefani 2011 Teubner edition available.
sources.notes: Greek text locked from PG 86b / Friedländer 1912. Ekphrasis of the Ambo of Hagia Sophia, recited separately after the main ekphrasis, likely at Epiphany 563 AD. 275 hexameter verses + 29 trimeter prologue.

sources.source: Lethaby, W.R. & Swainson, H. The Church of St. Sophia Constantinople. London: Macmillan, 1894. Chapter IV: The Silentiary's Account, Part 3. The Ambo. pp. 53-65.
sources.notes: Lethaby & Swainson 1894 is PD English reference for densify. New English must be from Greek, not copied from Lethaby.

pd_english_note: Lethaby & Swainson 1894 (Hakluyt Society) is PD English. New English for densify must be from Greek, not copied from Lethaby.
